macros.name: xelipaft
macros.doc: The space before the first character of the ellipses is \xelipbef; the space after the last character of the ellipses is \xelipaft; and the space between the characters of the ellipses is \xelipgap. Each of these default to 3pt.

macros.name: xelipbef
macros.doc: The space before the first character of the ellipses is \xelipbef; the space after the last character of the ellipses is \xelipaft; and the space between the characters of the ellipses is \xelipgap. Each of these default to 3pt.

macros.name: xelipend
macros.doc: Set up a special command, \xelipend, which omits the spacing at the end and can be used immediately before quotations or the like.

macros.name: xelipgap
macros.doc: The space before the first character of the ellipses is \xelipbef; the space after the last character of the ellipses is \xelipaft; and the space between the characters of the ellipses is \xelipgap. Each of these default to 3pt.

macros.name: xelipnum
macros.doc: The number of characters in an ellipsis is governed by \xelipnum.

macros.name: xelippostchar
macros.doc: The character that is to go before the ellipsis is \xelipprechar, while the character that is to go after the ellipsis is \xelippostchar.

macros.name: xelipprechar
macros.doc: The character that is to go before the ellipsis is \xelipprechar, while the character that is to go after the ellipsis is \xelippostchar.
